description: List the enabled inventory items (tours, activities, rentals, rooms). With NO dates this is the plain catalogue. Pass start_date (and end_date / param quantities) to get a RATED response: per-item availability, pricing and a SLIP token — the SLIP is what checkfront_add_to_booking_session needs to book the item. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item.

available.description: (rated) Only items with at least this many left in stock.

date.description: (rated) Alias of start_date for same-day bookings — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

discount_code.description: (rated) Discount code to apply to the price.

end_date.description: (rated) Booking end date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

item_id.description: Comma-separated list of item ids to filter to, e.g. 17,18.

keyword.description: Only items whose name contains this keyword.

param.description: Booking parameters (quantities) keyed by the parameter ids configured in your account, e.g. {"adults": 2, "children": 1}. Sent as param[adults]=2.

rules.description: 'soft' avoids date-based rule errors; 'off' disables rule checking.

start_date.description: (rated) Booking start date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

name: checkfront_list_items
title: List inventory items (optionally with availability and rates)
